name: FFS_SCHEDULING_STATS
description: Contains automatic routing statistics collected on bucket level for particular days.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the resource (bucket) which the statistics is collected for. It is the foreign key to the table FFS_RESOURCE.

columns.name: ROUTE_DATE
columns.description: Date which the statistics is collected for.

columns.name: TOTAL_EVER_MOVED_BY_SCHEDULING
columns.description: Number of activities that were scheduled automatically.

columns.name: EFFICIENTLY_SCHEDULED
columns.description: Number of efficiently routed activities.

columns.name: MANUALLY_PROCESSED
columns.description: Number of activities that were manually moved.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_BY_DISPATCHER
columns.description: Number of activities that assigned by a dispatcher.

columns.name: BUCKET_CHANGED_BY_DISPATCHER
columns.description: Number of activities that moved from a bucket to another bucket by dispatcher.

columns.name: REORDERED_BY_DISPATCHER
columns.description: Number of activities that moved by dispatcher to another position in the same route.

columns.name: UNSCHEDULED_BY_DISPATCHER
columns.description: Number of activities that moved by dispatcher from the field resource routes to a non-scheduled route.

columns.name: UNASSIGNED_BY_DISPATCHER
columns.description: Number of activities that moved by dispatcher from the field resource routes to a bucket.

columns.name: RESCHEDULED_BY_DISPATCHER
columns.description: Number of activities that moved by dispatcher from the field resource route to any route on another date.

columns.name: REASSIGNED_BY_DISPATCHER
columns.description: Number of activities that moved by dispatcher from a field resource to another field resource.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_BY_FLD_RES
columns.description: Number of activities that assigned by a field resource.

columns.name: BUCKET_CHANGED_BY_FLD_RES
columns.description: Number of activities that moved from a bucket to another bucket by field resource.

columns.name: UNSCHEDULED_BY_FLD_RES
columns.description: Number of activities that moved by field resource from the field resource routes to a non-scheduled route.

columns.name: UNASSIGNED_BY_FLD_RES
columns.description: Number of activities that moved by field resource from the field resource routes to a bucket.

columns.name: RESCHEDULED_BY_FLD_RES
columns.description: Number of activities that moved by field resource from the field resource route to any route on another date.

columns.name: REASSIGNED_BY_FLD_RES
columns.description: Number of activities that moved by field resource from a field resource to another field resource.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
